req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* is present on ALL responses. To achieve high mutation kill rate, tests must: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just presence, (2) cover multiple endpoints to confirm universality, (3) test that the header is absent when the CORS middleware is stripped (negative path), (4) test boundary endpoints like redirects and error status codes, and (5) test both simple and preflight-like requests. Each test imports the Flask app in-process and uses test_client() to avoid live URLs.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_and_exact_on_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_present_and_exact_on_get():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert acao is not None, 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin header missing'
    assert acao == '*', f'Expected "*" but got "{acao}"'

test_cors_header_present_and_exact_on_get()

tests.name: test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends a specific Origin header
actions: Send GET /get with Origin: https://example.com header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: Access-Control-Allow-Origin must be '*' (wildcard), not echoed origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Origin': 'https://example.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert acao is not None, 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin header missing'
    assert acao == '*', f'Expected "*" but got "{acao}"'
    assert acao != 'https://example.com', 'Header must be wildcard, not echoed origin'

test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin()

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: No endpoint is missing the header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on ALL responses (decision table across methods)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_present_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table():
    client = app.test_client()
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get', {}),
        ('POST', '/post', {}),
        ('PUT', '/put', {}),
        ('PATCH', '/patch', {}),
        ('DELETE', '/delete', {}),
        ('GET', '/headers', {}),
        ('GET', '/cookies', {}),
    ]
    for method, path, kwargs in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, **kwargs)
        acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
        assert acao is not None, f'Missing ACAO on {method} {path}'
        assert acao == '*', f'{method} {path}: expected "*" got "{acao}"'

test_cors_header_present_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table()
